high_level_description: This image captures a night sky scene with a prominent meteor or comet streaking across the upper right portion of the frame. The meteor is bright and elongated, leaving a trail of light as it moves through the atmosphere. The sky is dark, indicating that the photo was taken during nighttime. The lower part of the image shows a residential area with houses and trees. The houses have lights on, suggesting that it is either dusk or early evening. The trees appear to be bare, possibly indicating that the photo was taken during late autumn or winter.
